scope.encoded: All 39 sections of Title 1 are looked at; 35 have at least one tested function (ss 1-8, 101-106, 106a, 106b, 108-114, 201, 202, 204, 207-213) and 4 are inert (ss 107, 203, 205, 206). The six items of the time module (the last day of a period of days or weeks, of months or years, a last day on a day of rest, whether a date falls inside a period, the day and moment an enactment binds, the day subordinate legislation comes into force) and deemed service and the time words are named refusals because Title 1 has none of those rules; the text's own periods (ss 106, 204, 112b, 202(c)) are computed in the ordinary sense and labelled as such. The limbs left inert inside encoded sections are listed in NOTES.md.
scope.not_encoded: The canons of number, gender and tense and the word insane (s 1); the engrossing and enrolling procedure (s 106); the duties of compilation and distribution (ss 112, 112a(a), 112b(a)(1) lists, 112b(d)(4), 112b(e), 112b(h)(2)-(4), 112b(i), 112b(j), 112b(k)(1)-(3),(6), 202(a),(b), 210 first limb, 201 lead-in); ss 107, 203, 205, 206.
